name: Kierdan Waven
source:
Born into the powerful House of Waven and blessed with unparalleled skill with ice spells, Lord Waven easily climbed his way to the top ranks of the Imperial Magic Authority at the age of twenty-six. 
Calculating and commanding, he gives the impression that he's capable of anything — except, perhaps, communicating with others and showing emotion through his icy mask. 

[From [url=https://wind-chimes-games.itch.io/reanimation-scheme]itch.io[/url]]
